findings.description: Queued reconciliation commits start while retaining a live lease; the new current start intent generates a distinct owner and cannot dispatch until the preceding lease expires.
findings.required_evidence: A committed start intent can progress without waiting for the prior invocation's full lease TTL, while unique lease ownership and epoch fencing remain intact.
findings.source_correction: Admission.yield_multi uses the existing live-token guard and post-lock database time, expires coordination without releasing occupancy and returns no live token. Coordinator appends yield atomically to start/expire successor intents and yields after finished callback paths.

findings.description: After definitive finish releases occupancy, a current terminal intent tries to claim the terminal build; Admission rejects not_queued, so the coordinator does not reach its bounded infrastructure retry path.
findings.required_evidence: A retryable released terminal intent reaches Admission.retry_multi; it observes backoff, exact released evidence and CAS, with concurrent consumers creating only one subsequent attempt/job.
findings.source_correction: Terminal not_queued reaches Admission.retry_multi, whose capacity/build/reservation/lease lock sequence verifies current revision, exact released attempt evidence and cleared lease before replaying retry with sampled database time.

not_a_finding: Idempotent ensure_started may repeat for an already running operation. The safety assertion is stable operation identity and one external creation, rather than a count of callback invocations.
